hidden_state: Fan flow capacity and isentropic efficiency
physical_meaning: aerodynamic health scalars of the fan (fouling, erosion, FOD)
why_not_directly_measured: no sensor measures component efficiency; it is a model quantity
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: at fixed corrected thrust/N1: T5 up, Wf up, N2 shift; needs a gas-path model and corrected parameters to separate from ambient (theta/delta)
revealing_inspection_or_action: engine wash recovery; test-cell performance run; borescope for FOD/erosion
typical_trigger_or_interval: continuous drift (100s-1,000s h); step on FOD
degradation_drivers: particulate/salt/dust ingestion (Indian desert and coastal bases), FOD

hidden_state: HPC flow capacity, efficiency and stall margin
physical_meaning: compressor erosion (LE blunting), fouling, tip clearance
why_not_directly_measured: not measured; stall margin is never measured in service
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: PS3 lower and T5/Wf higher at fixed N2; stalls/pop-stall events become more likely during transients
revealing_inspection_or_action: test-cell run; borescope; stall-event investigation

hidden_state: HPT efficiency and NGV throat area (flow capacity)
physical_meaning: erosion, oxidation, TBC loss, vane bow
why_not_directly_measured: model quantity
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: 1 % HPT fault ~ N2 -0.6 %, Wf +0.6 %, EGT +12 degF, P3 -0.5 % (reference engine); T5 margin to limit shrinks; at limit, thrust loss
revealing_inspection_or_action: borescope (hot section); module removal and shop inspection

hidden_state: LPT efficiency / flow capacity
why_not_directly_measured: model quantity
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: small shifts (eta -0.5 to -1.1 % at 3,000-6,000 cycles, reference)
revealing_inspection_or_action: borescope; shop visit

hidden_state: HPT/HPC blade tip clearance
physical_meaning: radial gap between blade tips and shrouds
why_not_directly_measured: no in-service clearance probes on F404-class engines
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: ~+1 degC EGT and +0.1 % SFC per 0.001 in HPT clearance (reference); step after rub
revealing_inspection_or_action: borescope; shop measurement at overhaul
typical_trigger_or_interval: step at build/first flights, then slow growth; rubs on hard manoeuvres

hidden_state: Blade/vane crack length (HCF/LCF), coating loss
why_not_directly_measured: no crack sensing; vibration only reacts to large imbalance
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: usually no signature until liberation (stall codes, RPM drop, FTIT/T5 rise in seconds)
revealing_inspection_or_action: borescope; NDT at shop visit; fleet campaign inspections
degradation_drivers: HCF from wakes/flutter; LCF; FOD nicks
evidence_tag: TRANSFER: USAF F-16 AIB cases (F100/F110 blade failures); mechanism transfers, no Tejas data

hidden_state: Disk/shaft LCF life consumed (crack initiation fraction)
physical_meaning: fatigue damage in rotating life-limited parts
why_not_directly_measured: damage is not observable; only usage is counted
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: counters accumulate with throttle activity; no gas-path signature
revealing_inspection_or_action: life-limit removal per lifed-part tracking; NDT at overhaul
typical_trigger_or_interval: retire at limit (e.g. CF LCF limits 4,300-15,200 counts)
degradation_drivers: throttle cycles; AB use; hot-day operation
evidence_tag: DIRECT (Tejas ECMS computes LUIs) + TRANSFER (F404 limits)

hidden_state: HPT blade creep / stress-rupture life consumed
why_not_directly_measured: not observable
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: counters only
revealing_inspection_or_action: shop inspection; blade stretch measurement
typical_trigger_or_interval: EFT limit e.g. 30,000 EFT (CF DSR80 blade)
degradation_drivers: time at high T5; hot days

hidden_state: Main-shaft bearing spall size / debris mass
why_not_directly_measured: no in-flight spall measurement; debris sensing only at chip detectors (and vibration at late stage)
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: chips in oil (most common indicator), vibration rise, low oil pressure late
revealing_inspection_or_action: chip-detector inspection; SOAP/JOAP; filter debris analysis; borescope
typical_trigger_or_interval: onset ~500 FH in one Indian fleet history (Su-30 AL-31FP context)
evidence_tag: TRANSFER: Indian Su-30MKI AL-31FP failure statistics (other engine) + FEMTO bearing data

hidden_state: Oil/air seal wear and internal oil leakage
why_not_directly_measured: not instrumented
how_it_shows_in_measured_signals: rising oil consumption between servicings; level-low events
revealing_inspection_or_action: oil consumption trend from servicing records; borescope for coking

hidden_state: Oil degradation and contamination (wear metals, fuel dilution, oxidation)

hidden_state: FADEC electronics aging (connector, solder, component drift)
